Method of Attack: Incorrect handling of HEADERS and CONTINUATION frames
Attack Vector: Sending HEADERS and CONTINUATION frames without the END_HEADERS flag
Exploiting CONTINUATION frames to create a never-ending stream of headers
Indicators of Compromise: Requests not visible in HTTP access logs
